title: TRACE: Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation for Text-Vision Embedding Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.26993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing benchmarks for text-vision embedding models report aggregate scores that obscure whether performance comes from general capabilities, task-specific adaptation, or robustness to challenging tasks. We introduce TRACE, a Training-aware Robustness and Challenge Evaluation framework that reorganizes 168 tasks from various sources of datasets into three categories: General, Adaptability, and Challenge. Through controlled experiments on two text-vision embedding models, we show that combining general and adaptation data improves Adaptability performance by 7.67 and 7.09 points, respectively, while largely preserving General performance. However, Challenge performance remains below 5.0, with limited improvements from additional training data. Further analysis identifies multilingual and visual-document tasks as major weaknesses. Our findings demonstrate that data adaptation alone is insufficient to address these challenges, highlighting

translated_title: TRACE：面向文本-视觉嵌入模型的训练感知鲁棒性与挑战评估
translated_abstract: 现有针对文本-视觉嵌入模型的基准测试报告的是综合评分，这些评分掩盖了性能究竟来自通用能力、特定任务适应，还是对挑战性任务的鲁棒性。我们提出了TRACE，一个训练感知的鲁棒性与挑战评估框架，它将来自多种数据源的168个任务重新组织为三大类别：通用、适应性和挑战。通过对两个文本-视觉嵌入模型进行受控实验，我们表明结合通用数据和适应性数据分别使适应性性能提升了7.67和7.09分，同时基本保持了通用性能。然而，挑战性能仍然低于5.0分，额外的训练数据带来的改进有限。进一步分析发现，多语言任务和视觉文档任务是主要的薄弱环节。我们的发现表明，仅靠数据适应不足以应对这些挑战，这凸显了……
tldr: 本文提出TRACE评估框架，将168个文本-视觉嵌入任务重新组织为通用、适应性和挑战三类，实验发现混合通用与适应性数据可显著提升适应性性能但挑战性能仍低于5.0分，且多语言和视觉文档任务为主要薄弱环节，表明仅靠数据适应不足以解决这些挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRACE, a framework that reorganizes 168 text-vision embedding tasks into General, Adaptability, and Challenge categories, showing that combining general and adaptation data improves Adaptability performance while Challenge performance remains below 5.0, with multilingual and visual-document tasks identified as major weaknesses, demonstrating that data adaptation alone is insufficient.
